subject: general
question: Which of the following organisations is responsible for enforcing workplace safety regulations in India?

options.text: Directorate General of Factory Advice Service and Labour Institutes (DGFASLI)

solution:
The correct answer is __Directorate General of Factory Advice Service and Labour Institutes (DGFASLI)**(DGFASLI)**.__

**__Key Points__**

__
 
• DGFASLI__ is the technical arm of the Ministry of Labour and Employment, Government of India.
 
• It advises on the enforcement of the Factories Act, 1948, and promotes occupational safety, health, and welfare in factories and docks.
 
• The organization conducts training, research, and consultancy in workplace safety and health management.
 
• DGFASLI also oversees the implementation of safety standards and helps in formulating policies to ensure a safe working environment in India.

**__Additional Information__**

 
• **Environmental Protection Agency (EPA):**

 
 
• It is a US-based organization responsible for environmental protection but is not related to workplace safety in India.
 
 
 
• **Food and Drug Administration (FDA):**
 
 
• FDA oversees the safety of food and drugs but does not regulate workplace safety in India.
 
 
 
• **World Health Organization (WHO):**
 
 
• WHO is a global body focusing on international public health, not specific to workplace regulations in India.
